answer: Rate-capped standing accrual resists sybils: influence rises by at most a fixed small increment per epoch regardless of work dumped in — the slope is capped, so weight climbs a slow spiral, never a vertical plume. A swarm cannot buy instant standing by flooding activity; each fake must wander the same many epochs of real time to reach weight, and idle pre-made accounts sit at zero until they too climb. Flooding fails because time cannot be compressed: K fakes each need the full climb, sustained. Precondition: the per-epoch cap binds regardless of work volume.
